thesis: Hold. Items published after the prior 16:00Z cutoff and before this 16:30Z cutoff are two Federal Home Loan Bank Item 2.03 obligation filings (Atlanta 16:26Z, Chicago 16:06Z), a BayFirst Financial 8-K (16:17Z) that is only an Item 5.02 officer change with no named officer and no ticker in the summary, and a MarketWatch note (16:24Z) that the S&P 500 was trading within 2 percentage points of its record closing high while a bear-market breadth gap is left uncounted and unnamed. That note describes the tape and names neither the weak stocks nor what is holding the index up, so it is not a single-name entry and not a reason to add to the existing VTI lot (about $249, roughly 25% of about $999 equity) or to sell it. Context prints are VIX 16.30 (+0.23), the 10-year at 5.283% (+0.043pt), TLT 78.04 (-0.74%), and WTI 90.35 / USO 145.29 lower, still with no causal oil headline and no duration reversal, so cash stays unspent on energy and bonds. Carryover still lacks terms: Novo's second licensing deal names no partner, asset, or economics and sits against the same-day GLP-1 vision-risk note; TSMC's second U.S. site is an unconfirmed report; Carnival's Item 2.02 has no results figures; the junk-bond month recap and the weak-hiring feature name no ticker. Cash stays about $750. Header-only 8-Ks and House PTRs that name no symbols stay off the blotter.
